title: Raycast MCP
summary: View what's new in Raycast v2.13
body_markdown:
[v2.13](https://www.raycast.com/changelog/macos/2-13) November 18, 2026


Introducing Raycast MCP, a local server that lets agents like Claude, Codex and Cursor use Raycast. Turn it on in **Settings → MCP → Raycast MCP Server** and add it to your favorite AI app.


Your agent can then search your Clipboard History, create Snippets and Quicklinks, manage your apps and Auto Quit rules, work with your browser tabs, history and bookmarks, start Focus sessions, change Raycast settings and remember things across chats.


You decide which extensions to share, and everything runs locally on your Mac. Check the MCP settings for example prompts to get started, and the[Manual](https://manual.raycast.com/ai/model-context-protocol) for all the details.


## ✨ New


- **AI Chat** : Added Screenshots to the composer's add menu so you can attach a recent screenshot
- **AI Chat** : Mention specific contacts, calendars and calendar events in the composer
- **AI Chat** : The composer now supports code blocks, started with \`\`\`, and bulleted or numbered lists, and sent messages look exactly as you composed them
- **Calendar** : Added replying to invitations, all-day events, and repeating events with alerts and a time zone with AI
- **Clipboard** : Added tools to delete and pin clipboard entries with AI
- **Notes** : Added tools to delete and rename notes with AI
- **AI Extensions** : Quicklinks, Snippets, Store, Organizations, Raycast Settings and Extension Development are now available in Raycast AI and the Raycast MCP Server, plus Applications on macOS to find and uninstall apps and set up Auto Quit
- **Backups** : Raycast now creates an automatic backup of your data every week that it can recover if necessary
- **Calculator** : Convert, adjust and mix colors written as names or in formats like` rgb(18 249 153)` , such as` tomato as hex` , and check the contrast between two colors
- **Settings** : Added tutorial videos to Settings pages like General, Shortcuts, Automations and Clipboard History and a Watch Video action for commands that have one


## 💎 Improvements


- **AI Chat** : Archived chats are now sorted by when you archived them
- **AI Chat** : Code blocks without a language no longer show an empty header
- **AI Chat** : Opens and switches between chats faster, with fewer freezes while models sync or the window opens
- **Browser:** Now explains how to install or connect the Raycast browser extension when no browser is connected
- **AI Extensions** : Tools now page through long lists, return shorter responses and give clearer errors, so AI makes fewer mistakes
- **AI Usage** : Usage bars now mark how much of the usage period has passed, so you can see whether you're ahead of pace
- **Appearance** : Contrast improvements on controls that follow system accents
- **Clipboard History** : Search is about 50% faster and uses about 80% less memory
- **Cloud Sync** : Now pauses while your Mac is asleep, including during brief background wakes
- **Dictation** : New installs now finish dictation with Enter and cancel with Escape, and the Command shortcuts stay available in Settings → Dictation
- **Extensions** : Manage Extensions opens about 5× faster
- **Memory Usage** : AI Chat uses up to 75% less memory, and Raycast frees memory within seconds after you leave a view
- **Notes** : Typing, saving and the character count are much faster in long notes
- **Performance** : Saving is up to 75% faster and large libraries load up to 80% faster
- **Root Search** : Reduced occasional slowdowns caused by background account refreshes
- **Settings** : Opens faster when it goes straight to a specific page, like when opened from AI Chat
- **Startup** : The main window is ready sooner after Raycast launches
- **System** : Raycast now removes old copies of its Node runtime before installing a new one, freeing disk space
- **System** : Raycast responds faster right after your computer wakes from sleep
- **Updates** : Improved recovery options when macOS fails to register Raycast's background item during an update
- **Updates** : The Check for Updates menu bar item is now disabled when your organization manages updates
- **Calculator** : Weather understands the time anywhere in your query, like` weather tomorrow in sf` , and currencies convert without an amount, like` usd to thb`


## 🐞 Fixes


- **Account** : Fixed organization invites getting stuck loading after cancelling sign-in
- **AI Chat** : Fixed pasted mentions of extensions staying plain text in the composer
- **AI Extensions** : Fixed clipboard searches returning old entries instead of your latest copies
- **AI Extensions** : Fixed deleting the last remaining detail in Memory failing
- **AI Extensions** : Fixed Get Weather reporting wrong humidity and feels-like values in daily forecasts, and it now labels its units
- **AI** : Fixed the Command Line Tools install dialog opening again and again on Macs without them
- **Appearance** : Fixed app icons not updating when switching between light and dark mode
- **Applications** : Fixed apps like Print Center switching between localized names across launches
- **Applications** : Fixed Root Search showing no applications when Spotlight stops responding
- **Dictation** : Fixed the submit keyword not working when it was saved with punctuation, like Press Enter
- **Emoji Picker** : Fixed AI suggestions from a previous search showing up for a new one
- **Extensions** : Fixed OAuth sign-in not opening the browser again after a failed attempt
- **Focus** : Fixed blocked apps sometimes not quitting
- **MCP** : Fixed confusing errors when installing an MCP server whose URL isn't http(s) or whose server doesn't respond
- **Restart Frontmost App** : Fixed other instances of the app also being quit, and the app sometimes not reopening
- **Snippets** : Fixed key releases sometimes being held back while snippet expansion is on
- **UI** : Fixed alerts taking focus away from the app you're using
- **UI** : Fixed toasts sometimes appearing behind an open dialogs
- **Updates** : Fixed Check for Updates in the menu bar giving no feedback
- **Window Switcher** : Fixed the window list hanging when an app doesn't respond
- **Calculator** : Fixed` sqrt49` not being calculated and` mp3` ,` ps5` or` a380` being looked up as flights
- **Calculator** : Fixed date and time queries like` utc time` ,` today - 11/04/26` and` 9:00 to now`
- **Root Search** : Fixed web searches like Google and DuckDuckGo showing under Commands with an empty search
